remarks: Move right into this bright and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor apartment in a meticulously maintained multifamily residence. Filled with natural light, the spacious living room is warm and inviting while the updated kitchen and bath, gleaming hardwood floors, and in-unit laundry provide modern comfort and convenience. The kitchen features newer appliances including stainless steel gas range, refrigerator, and dishwasher. Assigned parking (2 spots). HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED! Ideally situated on a picturesque tree-lined street, this home is just moments from parks, schools, shopping, dining, and all that Cos Cob has to offer!
